transcript_segments.text: We're interested, but the enterprise price is higher than Zendesk and Intercom, and I still do not know what happens after the pilot.
We can probably work something out on pricing and I can send more details later once I regroup with the team.

source.notes: Realistic synthetic sales call with pricing objection, competitor pressure, and weak next-step clarity.
